reason: I can get a bottle of magnesium glycinate for way less per day, and I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles. $24.99 for a month of sachets is paying extra for convenience I don't really need.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and at about $0.83 a day it costs a lot more per day than the bottle I could grab at the store.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 for the month, or a small 7-day trial pack so I can see if I even take it before committing to 30 days.
